verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents its own export feature with open, readable options (an unencrypted ZIP or a CSV file) so data can be used elsewhere, and it stores TOTP for saved logins. However, no evidence explicitly confirms that TOTP secrets are included in those exports or in a form another authenticator app can import. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that TOTP seeds/otpauth URIs are included in unencrypted/CSV exports, evidence of compatibility with other authenticator apps, independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful TOTP migration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in

citations.quote: If you want to use your passwords elsewhere or create a separate hardcopy, you can easily export your data from Proton Pass.
Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
You can export your data from Proton Pass via our browser extensions, web app, and Windows app.
